actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE newly drawn game WALK sprite SW09-v1 for 09_bamboo_archer_girl, frame09 of a16-frame480ms seamless grounded cycle.
Reference1 identity, reference2 approved painting style, reference3 whole-character proportions/equipment, reference4 exact target direction/camera and stable costume layout from frame01. Keep camera and equipment from reference4 but change BOTH LEGS to the opposite contact, not the same pose.
Preserve this exact round-faced green-eyed chibi bamboo archer girl: dark brown long high ponytail, jade bamboo leaf/gold hair clasp, pale yellow-green ribbons, jade earrings, ivory and jade-green layered short Taoist tunic, gold leaf embroidery, ivory shorts, green/gold/ivory short boots, green tassel. Same 2.4-head-tall short-limbed proportions as reference 3; same fine clean painted volume. Anatomical left hand holds the original FULL-LENGTH bamboo bow by its gold middle grip at lower chest height, left elbow bent. Entire bow end-to-end 80 percent of total character height, top tip near head, bottom tip at ankle above ground, original jade segmented curved limbs and gold leaf tips, relaxed bowstring, NO nocked arrow. Matching quiver strapped to her BACK behind her anatomical RIGHT shoulder, arrows above that shoulder. Free right arm swings opposite legs. Never switch hands, move quiver shoulder, miniaturize bow, or add a weapon.
DIRECTION: SOUTHWEST, front three-quarter view, face and torso turned exactly45 degrees toward screen LEFT from front. Travel diagonally toward bottom-left. Show full face with nearer left cheek and both green eyes, nose points down-left. Front yin-yang belt buckle visible with proper perspective.
ANATOMICAL PHASE: RIGHT foot forward initial heel contact, LEFT foot trailing toe-on-ground. This is opposite-leg contact to frame01, newly drawn anatomy and equipment kept on their original sides. In N view left=screen left and right=screen right, forward is away/upward; in SW view forward is diagonally down-left. Both legs must have a distinct relation to reference4: switch which leg is ahead, NOT a mirrored copy. Keep mouth pleasantly closed where visible. Ponytail silhouette and body size stay almost unchanged, mild cloth response only.
One complete newly drawn full-body pose on ONE square native canvas at least1024x1024, preferably1536x1536, highest available visual quality. Original soft upper-left lighting. Fixed orthographic game sprite camera pitched down10 degrees. Head to grounded sole about84 percent of canvas height, vertical body axis centered horizontally, grounded sole baseline92 percent height. Keep full bow tips, hair, ribbons and both boots inside generous margin, no cropping. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, clear empty spaces also inside enclosed gaps between string/bow/hair/legs. No colored matte, painted checkerboard, floor shadow, backdrop, gradient, glow, text, number, frame border or watermark. One newly drawn genuine anatomical walking phase, no collage, no sheet, no repeated pose or mirrored anatomy; no hop, running, flying or attacking.
